candidate.scope: The single linear Illumina schematic titled Next-generation Capture-C (NG Capture-C), from chromatin fixation through capture-enriched DNA. Next-generation Capture-C is the expanded name of NG Capture-C, not another target. The cited primary NG Capture-C implementation additionally uses PCR from capture beads and a second capture round; those unshown stages are explained as an endpoint qualification, not added as diagram operations. No sequencing or analysis operation is drawn.

All nine labeled transformations and twenty material routes are represented, from chromatin through the capture-enriched DNA endpoint. The drawing contains one fragment mixture, with no independent specimen branches to preserve.
